old: Non si può negare che X provoca reazioni molto vivaci e continua ad alimentare
new: Non si può negare che X provochi reazioni molto vivaci e continui ad alimentare
reason: 'negare che' needs the subjunctive (as the app's own toolkit item says)

old: X est sans doute l'un des sujets les plus débattus
new: X est sans aucun doute l'un des sujets les plus débattus
reason: 'sans doute' = probably in modern French; EN says 'undoubtedly'

old: otras siguen sin convencerse y el debate
new: otras siguen menos convencidas y el debate
reason: EN 'remain less convinced', not 'remain unconvinced'

old: Secondo uno studio pubblicato da {SRC}
new: Secondo uno studio pubblicato dall'{SRC}
reason: with src 'l'ISTAT' renders 'da l'ISTAT' (needs dall'); pair with src.it change

old: l'ISTAT
new: ISTAT
reason: pairs with template 'dall'{SRC}' so output reads 'pubblicato dall'ISTAT'

old: Dans un article de {SRC}, on explique que
new: Dans un article du {SRC}, on explique que
reason: with src 'Le Parisien' renders 'de Le Parisien' (must contract: du Parisien); pair with src.fr change

old: Le Parisien
new: Parisien
reason: pairs with template 'du {SRC}' -> 'Dans un article du Parisien'

old: In un articolo di {SRC} si spiega che
new: In un articolo del {SRC} si spiega che
reason: with src 'il Corriere della Sera' renders 'di il Corriere' (must be del Corriere); pair with src.it change

old: il Corriere della Sera
new: Corriere della Sera
reason: pairs with template 'del {SRC}' -> 'del Corriere della Sera'

old: Secondo le informazioni contenute in {SRC}
new: Secondo le informazioni contenute nel {SRC}
reason: with src 'Rapporto Censis' renders 'contenute in Rapporto Censis' (needs article: nel)

old: Ça a du sens ?
new: Cela vous paraît logique ?
reason: 'avoir du sens' (make sense) is a condemned anglicism and 'Ça' too casual for the oral

old: Sopesando los pros y los contras, sigo convencido de que
new: Sopesando los pros y los contras, sigo convencido, no obstante, de que
reason: 'nonetheless' (quand même / comunque) missing in ES

old: Cuanto más lo pienso, más tengo la impresión de que
new: Cuanto más lo pienso, más tengo, no obstante, la impresión de que
reason: 'nonetheless' (quand même / comunque) missing in ES

old: Desde mi punto de vista, está de todos modos claro que
new: Desde mi punto de vista, de todos modos está claro que
reason: unnatural word order splitting 'está claro'

old: Estaríamos en el derecho de preguntarnos
new: Estaríamos en nuestro derecho de preguntarnos
reason: idiom is 'estar en su/nuestro derecho', not 'en el derecho'

old: malgré les progrès qui ont été bel et bien effectués dans ce domaine
new: malgré les progrès qui ont été bel et bien accomplis dans ce domaine
reason: collocation is 'accomplir/réaliser des progrès', not 'effectuer'

old: non penso che le cose siano vicine a cambiare
new: non penso che le cose stiano per cambiare
reason: 'essere vicine a cambiare' is a calque; natural 'stare per' (as item 127)

old: To clarify what I meant
new: To be clearer, what I meant is that
reason: EN did not match FR/IT/ES ('Pour être plus clair, ce que je voulais dire c'est que')

old: In connection with what you said
new: In connection with what you have just said
reason: FR/IT/ES all say 'have just said' (venez de dire / ha appena detto / acaba de decir)

old: Aparte de X (excepto)
new: Aparte de X (excepto X)
reason: placeholder X missing (cf. sauf X / tranne X)

old: Without (verbing)
new: Without (X verbing)
reason: 'sans que/senza che/sin que + SUBJ' introduces a clause with a different subject; '(verbing)' invites the error 'sans que' with same subject

old: Solo
new: Sólo
reason: house rule: keep 'sólo' with accent

old: A costa de INF
new: Aun a costa de INF
reason: 'even' missing: 'a costa de' = at the cost of; 'aun a costa de' = even if it means (cf. anche a costo di)

old: Like (following the example of)
new: Like X (following the example of)
reason: placeholder X missing (FR/IT/ES all have X)
